exposure: antibiotic use in the first 4 days of life
finding: Antibiotic exposure in early life has an immediate and persistent effect on the infant gut microbiome, selecting for potentially multi-drug resistant strains.
mod_finding: Infants born by C-section had different gut microbial composition compared to those born vaginally, with higher abundance of Proteobacteria and a higher frequency of antibiotic-resistance genes if exposed to antibiotics in the first 4 days of life.
